name: Tamatar Shorba
steps: Wash and chop the tomatoes. Slice onion, ginger and garlic. Lightly crush cumin, coriander seeds and pepper so they release flavour without becoming a fine powder.
Heat ghee and stir the crushed spices for 30 seconds. Add onion and soften for 4 minutes, then add ginger and garlic for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, water, sugar and salt. Simmer partly covered for 18–20 minutes until tomatoes collapse. Cool enough for safe blending and blend in small batches.
Pass through a sieve, pressing out the liquid and discarding tough skins and seeds. Reheat the strained shorba for 3 minutes, add coriander leaves and serve; it should be thin, not a thick purée.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
